title: Assignment lifecycle
description: Guide one contract-governed change from interactive Brainstorm through automatic delivery.

create-assignment.purpose: Create the Assignment identity and readable contract scaffold.
create-assignment.instructions: Run `specdev assignment "<description>" --json` and submit its JSON result.

brainstorm.purpose: Collaborate with the user and finish brainstorm/contract.md.
brainstorm.instructions: Edit the single contract until the user is comfortable, then run `specdev checkpoint brainstorm`.

sideChannelActions.purpose: Run optional Brainstorm review without advancing the contract gate.
Run focused research without advancing the Assignment.

approve-contract.purpose: Approve the exact final contract before automatic work begins.
approve-contract.instructions: Review the final verdict, textual divergence, dirty paths, and exact contract hash. Run `specdev approve brainstorm` only after the user explicitly agrees.

interaction.prompt: Approve this exact Assignment contract for automatic delivery?

sideChannelActions.purpose: Record optional Brainstorm review without approving the contract.

design.purpose: Use the worker profile to write design/plan.md with Tasks, guide selections, and acceptance coverage.
design.instructions: Run `specdev implement`; the same worker Attempt normally continues through Implementation.

implementation.purpose: Execute Tasks inline, collect authorized evidence, and write the concise outcome.
implementation.instructions: The active `specdev implement` worker owns this transition and starts review when complete.

implementation-review.purpose: Apply the frozen implementation review policy to the candidate and existing evidence.
implementation-review.instructions: Required review runs `specdev reviewloop implementation`; a policy waiver completes only after strict host evidence checks.

repair.purpose: Continue from current repository state and repair the first blocking review findings.
repair.instructions: The implementation review loop starts one continuation worker and submits its result.
